stages.title: International inequality
stages.sub: Explain why countries differ in income and how inequality can change as an economy develops.

steps.q: A poor country starts growing fast: at first, only owners of land and capital in cities profit, so the Gini coefficient rises. As it grows richer, education spreads and welfare systems develop, so the Gini coefficient starts falling. What shape would a graph of inequality against income per head trace out over this whole process?
steps.right: It rises then falls, like an upside-down U
steps.wrong: It falls then rises, like a plain U
steps.hint: Inequality went up early on, then came back down later, as the country got richer.
